data.title: Autofill Data Harvesting
data.description: Detects form autofill data extraction patterns consistent with infostealer behavior. Stealers like RedLine and Raccoon target browser autofill databases (Web Data, formhistory.sqlite) to harvest stored PII including names, addresses, phone numbers, and payment card details that facilitate downstream fraud.

detection.condition: selection and not filter_browsers and not filter_system

falsepositives: Browser profile migration utilities reading autofill databases during import
Form-filling accessibility tools for users with disabilities
